text.tspan: One AHU, one damper per room (ADR-0008):
Q_i = Q_fan · a_i / Σ a_j. Trimming the five healthy
dampers and raising the fan pushes flow through the
one damper still frozen at 0.15 — which is also why
compensation only works while that damper is open
10: cycle 1 — predict the fall cmd-31 owed us;
r = measured - predicted; S = max(0, S + r - 30).
S passes the suspicion threshold 0.6 h = 90 ppm
⇒ SUSPECT. No fault is published on suspicion
12: cycles 2 and 3, 60 s apart — S holds above
h = 150 ppm on BOTH. Two consecutive cycles is
single noise tail is gone by the next sample because
the CUSUM subtracts k from every one, while a stuck
damper clears h on every cycle from the first
13: only now, classify — fan power flat at 103 W,
the other five residuals quiet, overnight decay
